title: Unseen Oceans
hook: You've seen more of Mars than the ocean floor
script: You've seen more of Mars than the ocean floor What if you could drain every ocean overnight? You'd reveal Earth's tallest mountain range and canyons deeper than any on land But that's not even the strange part We have mapped more of the surface of Mars than the floor of our own oceans More people have walked on the Moon than have reached the deepest point of the ocean floor Over 80 percent of the ocean floor remains unseen, an area larger than the surface of Mars That number's worth a screenshot
